description: The base manifest: every class word a slide accepts WITHOUT a component declaring it, grouped by what it controls, and every front-matter register with the groups it stamps. lib/components/index.js builds MODIFIER_GROUPS from it; tools/build-base-docs.js generates lib/base/base.modifiers.docs.md from it. A group's tokens are listed here, or named by `source` when an engine resolver owns the word list (lib/base/base-manifest.js SOURCES). engineering/decisions/2026-11-19-deterministic-authoring-audit.md W5.

kinds.test: The first `_class` word: a key of the component catalog (`kpi`, `cards-grid`).
In this component's own `variants`; legal only after that component (`kpi spotlight`).
In a group of this manifest; it acts on a surface, and is offered where the component has that surface (`dark`, `rule-accent`).
A modifier spelled `no-X` or `with-X`, X a name in lib/core/switches.mjs (`no-footer`, `with-period`).
A front-matter key (`spectrum:`, `tag:`); it stamps the words of the groups it names below on every slide.
Markdown the engine detects (the eyebrow, the coda, the below-note, pills, marks) and `_directive:` comments; never a class word.
Stamped by the engine (`lat-*`, `cat-N`, `progress-N`, `color-*`); an author never types it, and lint flags one that is typed.

groups.name: mood
groups.label: Canvas
groups.summary: The slide's canvas: dark or light, whatever the deck's color mode.

groups.name: claim
groups.label: Claim
groups.summary: How far the content claims the stage, from framed to the true edge.

groups.name: density
groups.label: Density
groups.summary: Tighter spacing for a dense slide.

groups.name: accent
groups.label: Accent
groups.summary: The accent-colored canvas.

groups.name: typography
groups.label: Typography
groups.summary: The heading's period, and a fixed projection scale.

groups.name: venue
groups.label: Venue
groups.summary: The room the slide is sized for (`venue:` per slide).

groups.name: type-set
groups.label: Type set
groups.summary: The `typography:` register's set, per slide. Not offered: a deck speaks in one type set.

groups.name: mode
groups.label: Mode
groups.summary: The `mode:` register's look (`sketch`, `boardroom`), per slide. Not offered: a deck has one mode.

groups.name: marks
groups.label: Marks
groups.summary: How a chart spends color on its marks.

groups.name: marks-intensity
groups.label: Marks intensity
groups.summary: How strong the chart marks read.

groups.name: marks-source
groups.label: Marks source
groups.summary: The one hue `marks: tone` draws in: the heading ink or the accent. Not offered: a deck names it in `marks:`.

groups.name: headline
groups.label: Headline
groups.summary: The heading's treatment.

groups.name: rule
groups.label: Heading rule
groups.summary: The line beneath the heading.

groups.name: eyebrow
groups.label: Eyebrow
groups.summary: The eyebrow label's treatment.

groups.name: inline-code
groups.label: Inline code
groups.summary: How inline code spans draw.

groups.name: insight
groups.label: Insight label
groups.summary: The word on the Key Insight panel's tag.

groups.name: note
groups.label: Note
groups.summary: The below-note switch, and the warning callout.

groups.name: table
groups.label: Table
groups.summary: The universal table treatment and its reflow.

groups.name: state
groups.label: State stamp
groups.summary: A review state stamped on the slide.

groups.name: tone
groups.label: Review tone
groups.summary: A pass, warn, fail or skip tone on the slide.

groups.name: stamp-style
groups.label: Stamp shape
groups.summary: The shape a state stamp draws in.

groups.name: tone-style
groups.label: Tone shape
groups.summary: The shape a tone draws in.

groups.name: cards
groups.label: Card spacing
groups.summary: What a card row does with spare height.

groups.name: lift
groups.label: Card lift
groups.summary: The cards' elevation.

groups.name: corners
groups.label: Corners
groups.summary: Rounded or square corners.

groups.name: fit
groups.label: Fit
groups.summary: The `fit:` level for one slide (report, heal, trim).

groups.name: backdrop
groups.label: Backdrop
groups.summary: The finish backdrop's strength and mask.

groups.name: card-tag
groups.label: Card tag
groups.summary: The tag on a card: color, size, placement, alignment.

groups.name: logo
groups.label: Logo
groups.summary: The deck logo's placement and finish, for one slide.

groups.name: progress-rail
groups.label: Section rail
groups.summary: The section rail's position and style, for one slide.

groups.name: agenda
groups.label: Agenda
groups.summary: One agenda's style and page numbers. Not offered: the words act on an agenda only.

groups.name: card-rail
groups.label: Card rail
groups.summary: The spectrum accent on cards.

groups.name: spectrum
groups.label: Brand bar
groups.summary: The spectrum bar, its edge and its trim.

groups.name: decoration
groups.label: Decoration
groups.summary: The atmospheric treatments: a tint and a mark. A corner or edge tint takes a placement.

groups.name: placement
groups.label: Placement
groups.summary: The other two spellings of a tint's placement (`tint-at-tl`, `top-left`), equal to `at-tl`. Not offered: completion offers the `at-*` spelling.

groups.name: frame
groups.label: Stage frame
groups.summary: Where the stage sits in the frame, and the footer band's inset.

groups.name: chrome
groups.label: Chrome
groups.summary: The running frame: header, footer, page number, rail, logo.

groups.name: picture
groups.label: Picture
groups.summary: The one picture alone on its line becomes the slide's background, cropped to fill it (lib/core/placed-picture.mjs). `collage` also lists `bleed`, for its own tiles.

groups.name: section-mark
groups.label: Section watermark
groups.summary: The section number as a large ghost behind the slide, inside a deck with dividers (lib/forms/tile/watermark). `split-panel` also lists `watermark`, for its own panel letterform.

groups.name: switches
groups.label: Switches
groups.summary: The switches no other group holds: the pane spine, the finish, its backdrop, and the treatments back on.

groups.name: social
groups.label: Social
groups.summary: The safe area for a vertical feed.

groups.name: motion
groups.label: Motion
groups.summary: Whether a chart plays, how it builds, and how fast. `chart-anima` is the old `with-motion motion-build`.

groups.name: aliases
groups.label: Aliases
groups.summary: Component-scoped words lint accepts on any slide: the components that own them list them as variants. `banner-tag` is the old name of `tag-band`.

registers.why: Loads a stylesheet; it stamps no class word.
Sets the canvas box; the engine reads it, no class word.
Tells a `divider` how to split; the divider reads it, no class word on other slides.
Lists terms the glossary layout reads; no class word.
Expands to the registers it bundles; it has no words of its own.
Stamps the engine's `color-*` classes, which an author never types; a slide uses `dark` or `light` (mood).
Stamps `finish finish-<name>`, an open vocabulary: a saved finish is any name.
Stamps the image card's classes, which the image-card register owns (lib/core/resolve-image-card.js).
Read by the player, not stamped on a slide.
Read by the narrated guide, not stamped on a slide.
Read by the narrated guide, not stamped on a slide.
